title.narrative: Restoring peaceful coexistence between communities in West Darfur

description.narrative: The overall objective of the project is to contribute to restoring peaceful coexistence between communities in West Darfur: - Mediation support to local authorities in cooperation with UNITAMS/UN contributes to the resolution of inter-communal conflict, the prevention of violence and sustainable peace in West Darfur. - Support to strengthen community early warning systems for stronger community protection. - Increased community engagements through community centres - Access to basic services
